KANNALAND POLITICS [6267]

By: Latashia Naidoo | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The Little Karoo is known for it's picturesque beauty. But the residents of its small towns say municipal failures are casting an ugly shadow on these picturesque hamlets.

Unique Selling Point:
The Kannaland Municipality is being run by convicted criminals.

Summary:
A convicted child rapist, a fraudster, and another convicted child rapist and fraudster walk into a room - and are all appointed to the highest seats of office within the Kannaland Municipality.
While it sounds like the punchline for a crass joke - it’s the reality of constituents in the Little Karoo, as their new Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Municipal Manager are all men with
‘questionable’ pasts.

Kannaland has a history of strange politics, but the recent re-appointment of Jeffrey Donson (who was in 2008 convicted of indecent assault and statutory rape of a 15-year-old girl), the leader of the Independent Civic Organisation of South Africa (ICOSA) has got people questioning ‘what exactly is going on?’
Earlier this year, he faced fresh allegations of sexual harassment from a 21-year-old woman whom he allegedly tried to extract sexual favours from.
His Deputy Mayor, Werner Meshoa, was fired as a primary school teacher for sexual misconduct with a pupil. He’s also been convicted for fraud and defeating the ends of justice.
And new Municipal Manager Keith Jordan, was dismissed by the George Municipality for alleged maladministration and the illegal investment of almost R350 million from the municipal coffers with Old Mutual.

But the newly-appointed leadership isn’t the only issue facing residents of Ladismith, Zoar, Calitzdorp, and Van Wyksdorp; EVERYTHING
is falling apart in Kannaland - water supplies, sewage, and rubbish collection; and rival gangs have taken these small town residents ransom. Yet the Kannaland Municipality website proudly declares it as ‘a municipality that works’.


Further information:
Amidst numerous party suspensions, and a history of motions of no confidence being brought against the current leadership, Mayor Jeffrey Donson says he won’t allow anyone to remove him from his ‘earned’ seat of power yet again – despite his criminal history and new allegations of sexual assault and harassment that have been levelled against him.

It seems to be a pattern within municipalities in the Karoo towns. In April this year, Patriotic Alliance leader Gayton Mckenzie was appointed Mayor of Beaufort West, capital of the Central Karoo district municipality. Once a gangster and a prison inmate, McKenzie’s now been tasked with cleaning up the Dodge City of the Karoo.

His predecessor, Truman Prince, aka. ‘The Prince of Pigs’, was another controversial figure who had previously been arrested for drunk driving, and was accused of molesting little girls. Yet, he was still appointed as Mayor of Beaufort West.

Press Release:


Kannaland Calamity

A convicted child rapist, a fraudster, and another convicted child rapist and fraudster walk into a room - and are all appointed to the highest seats of office within the Kannaland Municipality. While it sounds like the punchline for a crass joke – it’s the reality of constituents in the Little Karoo, as their new Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Municipal Manager are all men with ‘questionable’ pasts.

The Klein-Karoo is known for its picturesque beauty. But the residents of its small towns say municipal failures are casting an ugly shadow on these picturesque hamlets – this while the Kannaland Municipality is being run by convicted criminals.

Kannaland has a history of strange politics, but the recent re-appointment of Jeffrey Donson (who was in 2008 convicted of indecent assault and statutory rape of a 15-year-old girl), the leader of the Independent Civic Organisation of South Africa (ICOSA) has people questioning ‘what exactly is going on?’

Script:


KANNALAND – FINAL

CONFRONTATION:
MASA: “I am disputing your moral compass. That’s what’s in question here – not whether you were elected correctly or not –“
JEFFREY (SHOUTING): “Wat weet jy van morals?... Jy kan nie vir my kom vir morals!”
VO:
We’re used to explosive confrontations on the job…
It’s the nature of investigative journalism…
(BIG PAUSE BEFORE VO)
VO:
But there’s much more to this story than simply debating morality…
(PAUSE)
In fact… it’s about something a lot more sinister…
(PAUSE)
GILLION 23:28
When you’ve got a one-man party, where it’s a family that ultimately decides how things operate. I don’t think they’re a political party: it’s organised crime operating under the guise of a party… (PAUSE…)
VIZ: DRONE FOOTAGE OF SUN RISING OVER LADISMITH
VO:
Our journey begins a few hours east of Cape Town in Ladismith - a quaint Klein Karoo hamlet, famed for its port and cheese production…
(PAUSE)
VO:
This pocket of the Karoo falls under the Kannaland Municipality…
The town’s historic charm and natural beauty were not enough to prevent a collapse in service delivery.
(PAUSE)
VO:
From pothole-pitted streets…
To run-down buildings…
And endless water woes…
(PAUSE)
VIZ: OUTSIDE MUNICIPAL BUILDING
VO:
But the Kannaland Municipality is also fraught with leadership issues…
And something more… perverse…
(PAUSE)
MASA LINK OUTSIDE MUNICIPAL BUILDING
“Irregular expenditure, in-fighting, convicted fraudsters – these are the makings of this municipality. But also throw into the mix the re-election of a convicted child rapist – as the Mayor.”
VO:
This is Mayor Jeffrey Donson…
Also known as ‘DJ Fantastic’…
(PAUSE)
VO:
A career politician, he’s been a permanent fixture of Kannaland’s political landscape since the early 2000’s…
And leader of the ruling party in the council - the Independent Civic Organisation of South Africa (ICOSA).
TITLE THIS:
2004: STATUATORY RAPE
15 YEAR OLD GIRL
VO:
In 2004, while Mayor and a married man, Donson was arrested for statuatory rape and indecent assault of a 15-year-old girl. He was 42. (BIG PAUSE HERE)
VO:
In January 2008 he was convicted and sentenced to 18 months’ imprisonment. Donson appealed, and while the original guilty verdict was upheld, he was sentenced to nine months’ imprisonment, suspended for five years.
VO:
In October that year, Donson was re-elected as Mayor of Kannaland.
(PAUSE)
VO:
And like a cat with nine lives, in October this year, he once again donned the mayoral chain - after being ousted in January following a motion of no confidence – based on his criminal past.
VO:
Overnight, Kannaland and its brand of ‘strange politics’ attracted outrage, disbelief and widespread condemnation…
IAN CAMERON - 20221132_A7S30619 – GREG - 1:20
“To me it’s infuriating that in today’s – or in the current South Africa – that it can be allowed for a convicted rapist to become a Mayor in any place in the country. I think it’s an atrocity…”
VO:
Ian Cameron of Action Society has added his voice to resounding calls for Donson’s removal from power...
20221132_A7S30619 – GREG - 04:46
“We need to speak about this, we need to say: ‘Jeffrey Donson is a child rapist who is now the Mayor of Kannaland. It’s unacceptable. It’s an embarrassment to South Africa, and it’s a slap in the face of gender-based violence victims – not only in the Western Cape, but also the rest of South Africa.”
MASA QUESTIONS – MARTIAL – C0620 – 19:08
“What do you think it says about the constituents of Kannaland that they would want to be led by a convicted rapist, a convicted criminal?
GREG - 20221132_A7S30619 - 02:39
IAN: “I think it says something about the moral fibre of parts of certain communities in some parts of South Africa that they would elect somebody that is a known convicted child rapist. And that’s just what it is. Whether he wants to debate statutory or not, he needs to set a certain standard, we need a certain calibre of leaders that have integrity in South Africa.”
MASA LINK OUTSIDE COURT
“You may be wondering how someone with a criminal record is able to run for – let alone assume – the position of Mayor. Well, so did we. And then we started looking at the laws.”
VO:
Our Constitution says a criminal conviction isn't enough to disqualify someone from running for office or even being Mayor…
VO:
Donson’s re-appointment has sparked calls for urgent change.
VO:
Former DA constituent head in Kannaland, Gillion Bosman is all-too familiar with its unstable political terrain...
MASA: “It’s not just the mayor, Jeffrey Donson, it’s the deputy mayor as well, Werner Meshoa’s case, he’s also been convicted – of fraud. And here he is, the deputy mayor. What does this say about this administration that we’re dealing with here in this municipality?”
GILLION BOSMAN
22:00 - “I think when you’re a serial offender, you are insulting the people that you claim to represent. Because ultimately being a leader requires you to take responsible for your actions, a, but it also requires you to really reflect on what your capacity is and what your shortcomings are.”
VO:
In a place like Kannaland, Donson’s popularity isn’t altogether unexpected…
According to Bosman, ICOSA’s brand of politics favours favours…
GILLION BOSMAN
07:56N- “ICOSA used alcohol, ICOSA used bribery, and ICOSA used intimidation to persuade voters. Because when you go to Kannaland you’ll find that people go to ICOSA because they identify with Donson – because in Afrikaans they say ‘dis onse mense’ – they’re our people…”
GILLION BOSMAN
Bosman says ‘identity politics’ have also played a significant hand in ICOSA’s popularity…
“When we use identity politics to persuade voters, and we don’t use arguments of logic and we don’t use service delivery successes – we fail.”
VO:
We wanted to see for ourselves whether Donson’s two decades in power – on and off – had actually yielded any service delivery wins..
And find out why constituents continue to vote for him….
DRONE FOOTAGE - Van Wyksdorp
VO:
So we traveled through the Klein Karoo…
To the small mountain village of Van Wyksdorp – some 40 kilometres outside of Ladismith…
(PAUSE)
VO:
Where everyday life is one of astounding contrasts…
(PAUSE)
Against the backdrop of the Rooiberg Mountains… poverty is entrenched in this community…
VO:
Residents say ICOSA promised them a better life in exchange for votes during last year’s municipal elections…

02:13 (TRANSLATION:
“Hulle se as hulle kom en stemme, daarom belowe almal… hulle belowe die mense son, maanskyn en sterre. Maar as hulle die pos gekry, dan hulle vir die mense van Van Wyksdorp absolute niks doen.”
01:30
“Because he promised us toilets, and taps, and because they’re only one road. I don’t know, he said all the time he say he come back for toilets and taps and roads, but he never comes back. Since last year elections he never comes back.”
“Dis n’ gemeenskap wat by hokke bly…”
20221124_A7s30716 - 00:54
02:14
“Their motto is: ‘Ons lees is Kannaland, die munisipaliteit wat werk’. And I’m sorry but when I see those pamphlets it makes me a little bit sad, because that’s actually not true.”
VO:
But it’s not just constituents who are concerned…
VO:
The state of affairs of Kannaland - which has been placed under administration twice before - has also been on the radar of both local and national government…
VO:
A day before our visit to the municipality, its dirty laundry was aired in Parliament…
VO:
… where issues around governance and service delivery failures were discussed…along with the appointment of a controversial new acting municipal manager.
VO:
We’d planned on using these as talking points with Donson…
VIZ:
WHATSAPP MESSAGES, EMAIL
VO: Having scheduled an interview with him on municipal issues and - specifically - his rape conviction.
VO:
But when we got there… things took a heated turn…
JEFFREY DONSON INTERVIEW: Greg – 20221124_A7s30664
15:50
MASA: “Sir, did you think that at any point that you would conduct an interview and that your rape conviction wouldn’t come up? You should always be prepared to answer this. Whether it’s 18 years ago, whether it’s 20 years ago.”
JEFFREY: “Jy kan mekaar kom en jou aan mekaar se – ek kan nie vir jou oor dit praat. As dis het gebeur in die verleder. Se dit oor en oor ek sal dit nie entertain. Se dit oor en oor dat…”
VO:
But we weren’t backing down…
JEFFREY DONSON INTERVIEW:
07:24
MASA: “So you’re fully aware that the Commission for Gender Equality is against this. You’re fully aware that there’s been motions of no confidence against you. Councilors, people are saying – ‘This is wrong!’ You’re fully aware of all of this. You’re speaking as if you’ve got all this support.”
07:39
“It’s nie a punt of ‘aware of it’…”
WALKING OUT
In handing down sentencing in 2008, Cape High Court Judge Lee Bozalek said Donson had abused his power and influence.
17:30
MASA: “You’re still a convicted child rapist, and you’ll always have to answer to that.”
J: “Maak nie saak nie. Maak nie saak wat jy se nie, ek weet wat ek wee ten die gemeenskap weet wat ek weet, want hulle was in die hof gewees, hulle was in die hof.”
M: “You’re comfortable with your conviction, is what I’m getting. Thank you, goodbye.”
MASA LINK POST CONFRONT: GREG 20221124_A7s30679
“We had a 9am interview scheduled with Mayor Jeffrey Donson. When we got to his offices he made it very clear that he would not be discussing his rape conviction. But that’s exactly what we wanted to talk about. He kept going on that he was never sent to jail for this crime, but the point is: he was convicted of raping a 15 year old.”
VO:
As things stand, Kannaland remains a municipality in crisis…
VO: All while Donson and his allies hold onto their prized places on the municipal mantles - power-drunk off being voted into power by the residents of the Klein Karoo…

MASA: “Jeffrey Donson has also been quoted saying that the people voted for him, and that it’s outsiders like yourself who are imposing their views, and you should leave them to govern Kannaland.”
IAN CAMERON - 20221132_A7S30619 – GREG - 27:31 - “The message is quite simple to Jeffrey Donson: the day that he raped the child, it became all of our problems – and it’s as simple as that.”
__________________________________________________
PROMOS:
MASA LINK OUTSIDE MUNICIPAL BUILDING:
“The Kannaland Municipality in the Klein Karoo has a history of ‘strange’ politics. But it’s the recent reappointment of a controversial Mayor that’s sparked moral outrage.”
GILLION BOSMAN
06:40
“It’s the failure of our criminal justice system, because in any real society, a convicted rapist should not be allowed a, near schools dealing with kids, should not be allowed near any public building where minors are allowed…”

MASA PROMO LINK 2:
“It sparked moral outrage and demands for electoral reform. We investigate how a convicted child rapist was appointed to the highest seat of office in a small Karoo town.”

PROMO 3:
“The Western Cape’s smallest and poorest municipality has had a merry-go round of leadership changes in recent years… And it’s facing its fiercest battle yet.”

PROMO 4:
“Amidst the imperfect beauty of the Little Karoo - “a political storm is brewing. This time, over the recent reappointment of a Mayor - with a sinister past.”
“Someone that has to govern or has to be a leader of some sort must be held to a higher standard than the average citizen.”

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): The Little Karoo is known for it's picturesque beauty. But the residents of its small towns say municipal failures are casting an ugly shadow on these picturesque hamlets.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: The Kannaland Municipality is being run by convicted criminals.
metadata.Summary: A convicted child rapist, a fraudster, and another convicted child rapist and fraudster walk into a room - and are all appointed to the highest seats of office within the Kannaland Municipality. While it sounds like the punchline for a crass joke - it’s the reality of constituents in the Little Karoo, as their new Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Municipal Manager are all men with ‘questionable’ pasts. Kannaland has a history of strange politics, but the recent re-appointment of Jeffrey Donson (who was in 2008 convicted of indecent assault and statutory rape of a 15-year-old girl), the leader of the Independent Civic Organisation of South Africa (ICOSA) has got people questioning ‘what exactly is going on?’ Earlier this year, he faced fresh allegations of sexual harassment from a 21-year-old woman whom he allegedly tried to extract sexual favours from. His Deputy Mayor, Werner Meshoa, was fired as a primary school teacher for sexual misconduct with a pupil. He’s also been convicted for fraud and defeating the ends of justice. And new Municipal Manager Keith Jordan, was dismissed by the George Municipality for alleged maladministration and the illegal investment of almost R350 million from the municipal coffers with Old Mutual. But the newly-appointed leadership isn’t the only issue facing residents of Ladismith, Zoar, Calitzdorp, and Van Wyksdorp; EVERYTHING is falling apart in Kannaland - water supplies, sewage, and rubbish collection; and rival gangs have taken these small town residents ransom. Yet the Kannaland Municipality website proudly declares it as ‘a municipality that works’.
metadata.Further information: Amidst numerous party suspensions, and a history of motions of no confidence being brought against the current leadership, Mayor Jeffrey Donson says he won’t allow anyone to remove him from his ‘earned’ seat of power yet again – despite his criminal history and new allegations of sexual assault and harassment that have been levelled against him. It seems to be a pattern within municipalities in the Karoo towns. In April this year, Patriotic Alliance leader Gayton Mckenzie was appointed Mayor of Beaufort West, capital of the Central Karoo district municipality. Once a gangster and a prison inmate, McKenzie’s now been tasked with cleaning up the Dodge City of the Karoo. His predecessor, Truman Prince, aka. ‘The Prince of Pigs’, was another controversial figure who had previously been arrested for drunk driving, and was accused of molesting little girls. Yet, he was still appointed as Mayor of Beaufort West.
